title: 한여름 밤의 카라잔 원본 카드: 한국 대전 사용일과 변경일 독립 증거 검토

scope.status: Evidence report, not a claim that every historical functional change is verified.

conclusions: Prologue and Parlor ordinary availability starts 2016-08-12 KST. Opera 2016-08-19, Menagerie 2016-08-26, Spire 2016-09-02. August 10 client preload, reveal and PvE previews are excluded.

Later-wing dates are proven ordinary-use upper bounds. No contemporaneous exact-ID ordinary-generation evidence was found that justifies moving them earlier; this is not proof that earlier generation was impossible.
KAR_021 Wicked Witchdoctor cost 4→3 on 2023-08-23 was a material missing numeric change in the earlier history.
Original IDs were checked separately from CORE_ and other reprint variants. Later Core announcements only supply patch timing where the actual original change is independently observed.
Malchezaar Imp 1→2 belongs to 34.0.2/2025-11-14, not the later 34.6 first-sampled archive. Curator wording simplification belongs to 35.0/2026-03-11, not 35.0.3.
Atiesh ELITE-tag addition is only a raw client observation here. Its displayed rarity/visual change has not been established from a contemporary image or explicit Korean patch note.
datePolicy: Use explicit Korean effective-day wording or a Korean contemporaneous launch report. Where a UTC timestamp is used, state conversion and exactly what it timestamps. Archive timestamps never establish a live date.

preload.supports: Korean August 10 preload is distinct from August 12 ordinary availability.

launch.supports: Prologue and Parlor launch announcement, prologue rewards Raven and Firelands Portal; global header is August 11.

launch_kr.supports: Contemporaneous Korean report that prologue and first wing opened on August 12.

opera.supports: Contemporaneous Korean Opera opening report; opening August 19.

menagerie.supports: Contemporaneous Korean Menagerie opening report; opening August 26.

spire.supports: Contemporaneous Spire opening report September 2. Its retrospective August 13 first-wing statement conflicts with official August 12 and is not adopted.

wings.supports: Boss rewards and class-challenge assignment, checked against Korean HOW_TO_EARN in original CardDefs.

wings_guide.supports: Contemporary wing guides and release chronology; US days are not Korean days.

p62.supports: Korean 6.2 effective day and Ethereal Peddler clarification, not a functional change at this event.

p71.supports: Title specifies March 1; global publication header February 28 is not Korean effective day.

p80.supports: 8.0 effective Korean day April 5. Also explicitly fixes immune heroes being unable to play health-cost cards above current health.

p84.supports: 8.4 Korean day. Direct bare URL failed but indexed official page and text were inspected.

p90.supports: 9.0 Korean day, distinct from Frozen Throne opening August 11.

p100.supports: 10.0 patch Korean day, distinct from expansion opening December 8. No Atiesh rarity-display statement found.

p110.supports: Korean 11.0 patch day April 11; explicit Ethereal Peddler discount no longer persists through replaced cards.

p120.supports: Korean 12.0 effective day and link to copying rules explainer.

copy_rules.supports: Deck-to-play copies retain enchantments under 12.0; announcement precedes live patch. Also keeps Kindly Grandmother and Big Bad Wolf as Beasts, and Curator as Mech.

p122.supports: Korean 12.2 effective day. Card text specifics come from original-ID XML.

p140.supports: Korean 14.0 effective day, distinct from April 10 new expansion. Text specifics from original-ID XML.

p150.relevantQuote: [[칠흑색 비숍]]이 전장 최우측이 아닌 자신의 우측에 하수인을 부활시킵니다.
p150.supports: Title August 2 gives 15.0 Korean day. Also explicitly changes Barnes copies under Crystal Core from 4/4 to 1/1.

p1504.supports: Title August 27 gives 15.0.4 Korean day, global publication header August 26.

p182.supports: 18.2 Korean patch day September 9 corroborated by contemporary Korean patch report; wording specifics from original-ID archive.

p182_kr.supports: Contemporaneous Korean 18.2 report used as corroboration, not independently reread in this pass.

p200.relevantQuote: 적용 날짜가 표기되지 않은 변경 사항은 3월 26일 패치와 함께 적용됩니다!
p200.supports: Original-card 20.0 changes take effect March 26, not expansion March 31. Spell schools introduced; originals checked separately from Core versions.

p260.relevantQuote: 플레이어가 면역 상태이거나 천상의 보호막이 부여되어 있어도 생명력을 비용으로 내야 합니다.
p260.supports: 26.0 Korean day April 5; adjusted Core cards change with patch, roster rotation April 12. Explicit health-cost versus immunity general rule.

p272.supports: 27.2 Korean patch August 23 changes already-owned originals; Caverns of Time launch September 1 is not the original-card effective date. Table names all 8 affected Karazhan cards.

p320.supports: 32.0 Korean day March 19; exact original Curator and Historian changes verified in XML, not inferred solely from Core images.

p3402.supports: 34.0.2 names Malchezaar Imp cost 1→2 and says live today. Global page headerNovember 13 requires Korean corroboration.

p3402_kr.supports: Contemporaneous Korean 34.0.2 publication, paired with official live-today patch and original build 231191.

p350.supports: 35.0 Korean effective day March 11; exact Curator wording comes from original-ID XML 237510, not later 35.0.3.

p370.supports: 37.0 explicitly gives Korean October 14 patch/pre-release timing; expansionOctober 21 is separate. Exact punctuation changes from original-ID XML.

moat_hotfix.relevantQuote: a server-side hotfix rolling out now
moat_hotfix.supports: 27.0.1 explicitly fixes Moat Lurker re-summoning the targeted minion on wrong board side. The text announces active rollout, not a future plan.

moat_raw.supports: Raw metadata inspected: staff first post created 2023-07-28T 17:00:20.721Z, updated 2023-07-28T 22:02:21.276Z. Both convert to July 29 KST. No server completion telemetry.

58213.dateConfidence: medium-high; official event dates support patch day, direct actual first-live telemetry not inspected
